title: RedisCache only accepts values that can be pickled
author: codenprogressive

comments.author: AntonioABLima
comments.body:
Thanks so much for the detailed report — the standalone reproduction, the traceback, and the root-cause analysis (the `except pickle.PicklingError` not catching the bare `TypeError` from `SSLContext`) made this very easy to confirm.

I've reproduced it locally and verified the issue is present on `main` (1.10.0) as well as the `release-1.10.1` and `release-1.11.0` branches: `RedisCache.set` only catches `pickle.PicklingError`, while serializing a live model client raises a plain `TypeError`, so the cache write crashes the whole vertex build instead of degrading gracefully.

I've filed an internal Jira ticket (**LE-1621**) so the eng team can evaluate it and ship a fix. We'll follow up here once there's an update.

Thanks again for taking the time to dig into this — and for noting the connection to the earlier #13171 report!
